intent: Lay out an alert dialog's cancel and confirm actions at the bottom of the popup.
typical_uses: The row holding AlertDialogCancel and AlertDialogAction

dont_use_when.situation: The footer of a dismissible modal

invariants.text: The footer is sticky at the bottom of the popup with an opaque background matching it, so content scrolling inside AlertDialogContent passes under it rather than through it.
The footer reads its layout off the enclosing popup's `size`, not off a prop of its own; its source order is also its row order, so the cancel placed first sits at the start of the row.

anti_patterns.dont: Put the confirming action before the cancel
anti_patterns.do_instead: Place AlertDialogCancel first and AlertDialogAction last, so the action ends the row at the default size and tops the stacked layout of a narrow viewport

good.title: Cancel first, the confirming action last

bad.title: Plain Buttons in place of the close parts
bad.why: A plain Button does not close the alert dialog; AlertDialogCancel and AlertDialogAction are the primitive's Close rendered as a Button, so pressing either one closes it.
